newsitem.title: USA: Marathon $1 bln debt reduction on target.
newsitem.headline: Marathon $1 bln debt reduction on target.

text.p: USX-Marathon Group, a unit of USX Corp, said Monday it is on schedule to reach its $1 billion debt reduction goal by the end of the year.

The company said it expects a modest decline of liquids production in 1997, but that it foresees its production at 221,000 barrels per day in 1999, up 40,000 barrels per day over this year's expected levels.
The company said natural gas volumes are expected to remain in the 1.2 to 1.3 billion cubic feet per day range.

The company said future exploration activities will concentrate in the Gulf of Mexico, where a dozen or more wildcat wells are expected to be drilled yearly. It also said it is reviewing plans to participate in a propylene venture at the Garyville, Louisiana refinery.

Capital, investment and exploration expenditures should average between $1 billion and $1.1 billion yearly during 1997 to 1999, compared to an average of about $810 million over the three-year period ending this year, the company said.
The company said it is targeting a return on capital employed goal of 12 percent by 1998.
